∀ {p n : Nat} [Fact (Nat.Prime p)] {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] [CharP.{u_1} k p] {G : Type u_2}
  [inst_2 : Group.{u_2} G] [inst_3 : Fintype.{u_2} G],
  Eq.{1} (Fintype.card.{u_2} G) (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} p n) →
    ∀ {V : Type u_3} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} V] [inst_5 : Module.{u_1, u_3} k V]
      (ρ : Representation.{u_1, u_2, u_3} k G V),
      IsSimpleModule.{max u_2 u_1, u_3} (MonoidAlgebra.{u_1, u_2} k G) (Representation.asModule.{u_1, u_2, u_3} ρ) →
        ∀ (g : G), Eq.{u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} ρ g) LinearMap.id.{u_1, u_3}
